note: Inputs for scripts/fast_test_rank.py. Product facts come from candidates_*.json in this folder. Every value here carries a label and a source.

meta_cpa_benchmark_usd._source: Triple Whale Facebook ads benchmarks, median cost per purchase, Nov 2025 to Oct 2026, 41,000+ brands, read 2026-11-21 (04_reality_and_benchmarks.md, section 10). Established brands, not new stores.

refund_pct_china_shipped.label: ASSUMED
refund_pct_china_shipped.source: CLAUDE.md high scenario used as the base for 10 to 15 day delivery; real refund rate by shipping speed is UNKNOWN (04_reality_and_benchmarks.md)

cost_stress_multiplier.label: ASSUMED
cost_stress_multiplier.source: supplier costs are marketplace search-card prices read during a Black Friday promotion; this checks the product still earns money if the real cost is 20% higher

shopify_first_month.label: ESTIMATED
shopify_first_month.source: Shopify $1/month for the first 3 months (CLAUDE.md section 0; verify at signup)

domain.label: ASSUMED
domain.source: typical .com first-year price; verify at purchase

supplier_app.label: ESTIMATED
supplier_app.source: ordering by hand from a US-stock listing needs no app; Zendrop with 1 to 20 products is $29/month (03_fulfillment_and_money.md)

learning_phase_purchases_per_week.label: VERIFIED
learning_phase_purchases_per_week.source: Meta Business Help Center, about 50 results per ad set per week (04_reality_and_benchmarks.md)

category_rules._note: Which Meta benchmark each product uses. Each scout file has a default. In the two mixed files a keyword in the product's category picks the benchmark; if more than one matches, the more expensive one is used.

ad_budget_usd.label: ASSUMED

average_order_usd.source: Triple Whale median Meta AOV, all industries, Nov 2025 to Oct 2026 (04_reality_and_benchmarks.md)

creator_month.label: ESTIMATED

rule_review._source: Our reading of each product against CLAUDE.md section 2 (out of scope: significant safety risk, high return complexity) using the scouts' ip_safety_flags. Dhruv can overrule.

blocked.jump-starter-air-compressor: High-current lithium pack clamped to a car battery; certification UNKNOWN. The scout flagged it as a likely fail on safety.
blocked.dog-force-dryer: Mains-powered heated appliance used on animals; electrical certification UNKNOWN; over 10 lb.
blocked.towel-warmer-bucket: Mains-powered heating appliance; electrical certification UNKNOWN; over 9 lb.
blocked.cordless-heated-blanket: Battery-heated textile; certification UNKNOWN; no US stock found.

caution.heated-gloves-7v: Lithium packs and a heating element worn on the body; battery paperwork (UL, ETL or UN38.3) UNKNOWN; sizing returns; season ends by March. The cost is a listing with 3 sold.
caution.heated-vest-powerbank-kit: Heating element worn on the body; two sellers and two parcels; sizing returns.
caution.heated-socks-app: Lithium packs worn against the leg; certification UNKNOWN; sizing returns.
caution.cordless-tire-inflator: Lithium battery with a motor; certification UNKNOWN; two giant brands.
caution.mattress-vacuum-uv: UV light: no germ-killing or health claims allowed without proof.
caution.japanese-style-knife-set: The $26.49 cost is a 15-piece block set with 12 sold, not the gift set the $99 price is based on. Meta's ad rules on bladed items do not clearly allow kitchen knives. Never call it Japanese-made unless it is.
caution.rechargeable-wall-sconce-pair: Amazon sells sets of 2 at $45 to $57 with Prime, about half our price. The cost is one listing with 12 sold.

proven_listing_cost_usd._source: The battle skeptic's re-check of the three products that earn money on the cheapest listing: the cost of the better-proven or closer-matching US listing in candidates_*.json (battle.json, refute)

rechargeable-wall-sconce-pair.note: style closer to the Amazon best sellers ($45.91 to $52.89)
